# PiggyVest
Lagos, Nigeria Financial Technology Private

PiggyVest is Nigeria's largest digital savings and investment platform, enabling users to automate savings, invest in pre-vetted opportunities, and manage personal finances. The platform offers multiple savings products including AutoSave, Target Savings, QuickSave, SafeLock, and Flex Dollar accounts, with interest rates ranging from 5-20% on savings and up to 35% on investments. As of 2025, PiggyVest serves nearly 7 million registered users and has disbursed over ₦3 trillion to users cumulatively.
